 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Fabrizio Romano has confirmed that Real Madrid will sign Latif Issman from UD Logroñés on a contract that will run until 2030.
 The young Ghanaian is set to join Real Madrid Castilla, just like JJ Gabriel , in the summer of 2027, making him the first addition to the club's plans for the 2027-28 campaign.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Notably, the agreement was finalised yesterday after Real Madrid renewed their pursuit of the midfielder .
 Real Madrid secure Issman after renewed negotiations
 Real Madrid had initially explored the possibility of signing Issman towards the end of the previous summer transfer window, but negotiations with UD Logrones failed to produce an agreement.
 The club continued to maintain their interest and returned to the discussions in recent weeks, eventually reaching a breakthrough.
 Mourinho will want to keep a close eye on Latif Issman's development. (Photo by Juan Manuel Serrano Arce/Getty Images)
 For what it is worth, the existing relationship between the two clubs helped facilitate the deal.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement They had previously worked together on the transfer of Manex Rezola to Real Madrid, with that agreement providing a foundation for further negotiations.
 As for Issman, the transfer fee is reportedly relatively modest, although performance-related objectives could increase the final amount.
 Issman will remain at Logrones until the end of the current season before moving to Madrid.
 Who is Latif Issman and what does he offer?
 Issman has become an important figure at Logrones under manager Unai Mendia.
 Real Madrid have also signed JJ Gabriel for the youth team. (Photo by Charles McQuillan/Getty Images)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement His development has been driven by his physical presence, defensive commitment and ability to cover considerable ground in midfield.
 A right-footed midfielder standing 1.80 metres tall, he is comfortable competing for possession, pressing opponents and supporting attacking moves with forward runs.
 His biggest strength is his energy and willingness to do the demanding work in central areas.
 He generally favours simple passes and quick combinations, although there are technical aspects of his game that still require refinement.
